title: AHA install result
description: The outcome of install or status.

root.description: The root directory the paths are relative to.

harnesses.description: One entry per harness named, in the tool's order.

warnings.description: Content an agent may load twice.

Scope.description: Where a harness integration is installed.

oneOf.description: The project: files beside the project's own files.

The user: files under the home directory, in each harness's own
configuration directory.

The project's local, git-ignored files (e.g.
`.claude/settings.local.json`), under the project root.

HarnessResult.description: One harness's part of the outcome.

parts.description: One entry per part, in profile order.

unsupported.description: The integration's items the harness does not take at the scope.

notes.description: What the user still has to do.

state.description: The part's state before any write.

action.description:
What `install` did; `None` when the part was left as found, and
always for `status`. Left out of the JSON when `None`.

path.description:
The part's path relative to the root, `/`-separated; an external
part's location; a shared part's covering location.

by.description:
The harness that writes a shared part. Left out of the JSON when
`None`.

oneOf.description:
Another harness's part puts the same content in a location this
harness loads; nothing is written for it.
The file, the block or the entries are not there.

Differs from the tool's content and equals the recorded hash: the
tool wrote it and has changed since.
Differs from both, or present with no recorded hash.

Action.description: What install did to a part.

oneOf.description:
A region or merge part written into the existing file, or an
external part written again.

Item.description:
One kind of thing in an integration. An item becomes at most one part
per harness, named by the item's name (e.g. `hooks`).
